dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Nice teahouse you've got here. I can see you put a lot of thought into the furniture and teaware.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Personally, I think a few pets would complete the atmosphere... What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Oh, and don't worry, you can leave them to me to take care of.
